I opened the page. The words are there, exactly as quoted.

**1. The page.** It is a podscripts.co transcript of the Big Technology Podcast episode "Could LLMs Be The Route To Superintelligence? — With Mustafa Suleyman". The page gives the date as November 12, 2025. At 00:33:34 Suleyman says:

> "...The ability to access knowledge, the ability to use that knowledge to get stuff done, to write new programs, to do new scientific discovery, to get access to AI companions and emotional support. These things are going to be zero marginal cost in a decade."

A transcript counts as a primary source, so this is not coverage only.

**2. The four parts of the rule.**
- **Part 1, the speaker and his role:** On 2025-11-12 he was chief executive of Microsoft AI, which he held from 2024. The page itself introduces him as "the CEO of Microsoft AI", so that matches his role history. One caveat: the role history doesn't show whether Microsoft AI was already ruled to count as a frontier-model builder under A30. The 2024–2025 Suleyman files already recorded suggest it was.
- **Part 2, about AI and looking forward:** It says what AI services will cost to use: knowledge, getting things done, writing programs, scientific discovery, AI companions and emotional support. It is a forecast about how widely AI will be available, not a figure for company spending or revenue, so it passes. Someone might argue it is really a price forecast, but the earlier "zero marginal cost" claim (2024-06-25) was entered on the same reading.
- **Part 3, a date or a length of time:** "In a decade", a span counted from the day it was said, so it falls due in 2035.
- **Part 4, a primary source:** Yes, the transcript.
